embedding_description: Continue the planning inference loop with observation data. Planning VERTEX that runs the planning model to produce playbook content OR submit follow-up actions based on the observation. Used by the platform's planning pathway after an action's result lands. Distinct from create_plan (initial) and upsert_plan (write-only).
